Mutant Feature - Frog Head.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Frog Head
A broad, flat frog head with large high-set eyes on a human body.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Frog Head.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual selection only: a permanent Mutant feature of the body; keep it in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; Quirk traits decide what it can do. Features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. Quirkless or No Quirk means no heteromorph body: do not draw this feature.
Portrait: a frog's head on a human neck and body: broad and flat-topped, large round heavy-lidded eyes set high, a very wide mouth line, two small nostril slits, no external ears. Smooth skin with a slight wet sheen in the selected skin color, paler across the throat. The selected hair grows from the back of the crown; facial hair traits are skipped. If another Mutant Feature adds ears, a beak or tusks, this head's own anatomy takes precedence.
